2609.09887.title: When Does Defendant Statement Matter? A Study of Bias and Persuasion in LLM-Simulated Jurors
2609.09887.paper_summary: LLMs have been used to simulate human decision-making in professional settings, yet their behaviors in common-law jury trials remain unexplored. We study when and how a defendant's courtroom statement affects LLM-simulated jurors, focusing on persuasion, ideological bias, and background-based affinity. To support the analysis, we introduce JuryBench, a benchmark containing controversial criminal cases in U.S. criminal law. In each case, a defendant can claim various plausible justifications to support acquittal or reduced liability. We fix the base case and design defendants of different backgrounds, who give courtroom statements with varying emotional appeal or rebuttal. Jurors with diverse ideological profiles across the spectrum are simulated. We examine 20 frontier LLMs, resulting in a total of 432K decisions and rationales, and quantify changes in verdict severity. Our findings show that LLM-jury simulation echoes many human-jury findings. First, emotional persuasion can be detrimental, since jurors may perceive it as evidence of guilt or inconsistency. Next, we show that background fit between jurors and defendants is a stronger and significant factor than other isolated factors, and that jurors are in general harsher toward opposite-background defendants and lenient toward same-background ones. Finally, we find that juror ideology also strongly shapes severity judgments. These findings highlight both the promise and risks of using LLMs to model jury reasoning and call for careful evaluation. The data and code are available at https://github.com/choyingw/JuryBench
2609.09887.paper_summary_zh: LLMs 已被用來模擬專業環境中的人類決策，但它們在普通法陪審團審判中的行為仍未被探討。我們研究被告在法庭上的陳述何時以及如何影響 LLM 模擬的陪審員，重點關注說服力、意識形態偏見和背景相似性。為了支持分析，我們引入了 JuryBench，一個包含美國刑法中有爭議的刑事案件的基準。在每個案件中，被告可以提出各種合理的理由來支持無罪或減輕責任。我們固定基礎案例，設計不同背景的被告，他們在法庭上發表具有不同情感吸引力或反駁的陳述。我們模擬了具有多樣意識形態特徵的陪審員。我們檢查了 20 個前沿 LLM，總共產生了 432K 的決策和理由，並量化了判決嚴重性的變化。我們的發現表明 LLM 陪審團模擬反映了許多人類陪審團的發現。首先，情感說服力可能是有害的，因為陪審員可能將其視為罪惡或不一致的證據。接下來，我們顯示陪審員和被告之間的背景契合度是一個比其他孤立因素更強且顯著的因素，並且陪審員通常對背景相反的被告更嚴厲，對背景相同的被告則更寬容。最後，我們發現陪審員的意識形態也強烈影響判決的嚴重性評價。這些發現突顯了使用 LLM 模擬陪審團推理的前景和風險，並呼籲進行仔細評估。數據和代碼可在 https://github.com/choyingw/JuryBench 獲得。
